prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1479; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in League City, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of the roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that they were attempting a lane change to the left when Vehicle 2 moved into the same lane, causing a sideswipe collision. Driver 2 stated that Vehicle 1 drifted into their lane without signaling. Both drivers were cooperative. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was evaluated by EMS at the scene; they declined transport at that time. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 reported no injuries. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Photographs were taken of both vehicles and the roadway. Both vehicles were driven from the scene under their own power.
